description: The complete Germany income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: 2026 tariff (§32a), joint assessment with splitting and separate assessment, both computed; Employment with Werbungskosten: lump sum vs commuting (€0.38/km), home office, equipment; minijob; Self-employment with Gewerbesteuer and the §35 credit; statutory and Rürup pensions; rental income with AfA; Capital income: loss pots, Sparer-Pauschbetrag, Teilfreistellung, Abgeltungsteuer or the tariff (Günstigerprüfung); Private sales (§23) with holding periods and the €1,000 Freigrenze; Progressionsvorbehalt for Elterngeld, ALG I, Krankengeld; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in EUR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: A German income tax return (Einkommensteuererklärung) for 2026, for one person or a married couple. Amounts in euros for the year; leave out what does not apply.

allowance.description: Unmarried parents: half (default) or full child allowance

country_group.description: Non-resident: country group of the country of residence (BMF Ländergruppeneinteilung), 1–4: the €12,348 limit of the test to be treated as resident is cut to ¾, ½ or ¼ for groups 2–4. Default 1

eu_eea_national.description: Non-resident: national of an EU/EEA country (allows joint assessment with a spouse living in the EU/EEA, §1a)

filed.description: Filing dates, for the late-filing surcharge and interest

assessment_date.description: Date of the tax assessment (Steuerbescheid), YYYY-MM-DD: interest of 0.15% a month runs from 1 April 2028

filing_date.description: Date the return is or was filed, YYYY-MM-DD

with_adviser.description: Return prepared by a Steuerberater or Lohnsteuerhilfeverein (deadline 29 February 2028 instead of 31 July 2027)

filing.description: Married: joint (Zusammenveranlagung, default) or separate (Einzelveranlagung). Both are always computed

alimony.description: Maintenance to a former spouse (Realsplitting), euros for 2026

church_tax_paid.description: Church tax paid in 2026 (not withheld from wages), euros for 2026

craftsmen_labour.description: Craftsmen's labour and travel costs, not materials (Handwerkerleistungen; 20% off the tax, max €1,200), euros for 2026

extraordinary.description: Illness, care and other extraordinary costs, euros for 2026

household_minijob.description: Household minijob costs (20% off the tax, max €510), euros for 2026

household_services.description: Household services: cleaning, gardening, care (haushaltsnahe Dienstleistungen; 20% off the tax, max €4,000), euros for 2026

support_paid.description: Support paid to a dependent relative, euros for 2026

support_recipient_income.description: That relative's own income, euros for 2026

parent.description: Has had children (no childless care surcharge) even if none are listed

residency.description: Tax residence: resident (home or usual stay in Germany all year, worldwide income, default), partYear (arrived or left in 2026) or nonResident (German income only; the option to be treated as resident is checked)

single_parent.description: Unmarried parent living alone with the children (Entlastungsbetrag)

spouse.description: Spouse (married only): income, insurance and taxes withheld

other.description: Other wage replacement (Kurzarbeitergeld, Mutterschaftsgeld), euros for 2026

birth_month.description: Month of birth, 1–12 (decides when the statutory pension age is reached). Default 6

foreign_tax.description: Creditable foreign withholding tax, euros for 2026

fund_income.description: Investment fund distributions, Vorabpauschale and gains (before Teilfreistellung), euros for 2026

fund_type.description: Fund type for the Teilfreistellung. Default equity

other_gains.description: Other capital gains (bonds, derivatives), euros for 2026

other_losses_brought_forward.description: Other capital losses brought forward, euros for 2026

share_losses_brought_forward.description: Share losses brought forward, euros for 2026

withheld.description: Kapitalertragsteuer, Soli and church tax withheld by banks, euros for 2026

church.description: Member of a church that levies Kirchensteuer

disability.description: Degree of disability (Grad der Behinderung, GdB), 0–100; from 20 gives a lump sum

disability_h.description: Disability pass marked H, Bl or TBl (helpless or blind): €7,400 lump sum

employer_health_subsidy.description: Private health: tax-free employer subsidy, euros for 2026

gross.description: Taxable gross wages (Lohnsteuerbescheinigung line 3), euros for 2026

health.description: Health insurance: statutory (GKV, default), private (PKV) or none

pension_insured.description: Pays statutory pension and unemployment insurance (false for civil servants). Default true

private_basic_premium.description: Private health: yearly premium for basic health and care cover, euros for 2026

zusatzbeitrag.description: Zusatzbeitrag of the Krankenkasse, percent. Default 2.9 (2026 average)

credited_income.description: Foreign income taxed in Germany with a credit for the foreign tax, net of costs (e.g. foreign dividends at the tariff, foreign pension), euros for 2026

credited_tax_paid.description: Foreign tax paid on that income (credited up to the German tax on it, §34c), euros for 2026

exempt_income.description: Foreign income exempt under a tax treaty (DBA), e.g. wages for work done abroad or foreign rent: not taxed, but raises the rate (Progressionsvorbehalt), euros for 2026

while_abroad_income.description: Arrival or departure year: income earned abroad before arriving or after leaving (raises the rate), euros for 2026

world_income_outside_germany.description: Non-resident: all income not taxable in Germany, for the test to be treated as resident (at most 10% of the total or €12,348), euros for 2026

minijob_rv_exempt.description: Exempt from the minijob pension contribution

afa_amount.description: Depreciation amount, if given directly (overrides building cost × rate), euros for 2026

building_cost.description: Building share of the purchase price, euros for 2026

other_costs.description: Property tax, insurance, management, other, euros for 2026

rent.description: Rent received incl. recharged service costs, euros for 2026
